summary_en: 1,000,000 shares (2.2% of S/O ex-treasury) authorized for acquisition. Upper limit ¥150.0M. Acquisition window 10 Aug – 31 Oct 2026. Method: open-market purchases on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Stated rationale: capital-efficiency improvement and funding for incentive plans.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Nomura System Corporation's board resolved on 7 August 2026 to acquire up to 1,000,000 shares of its own stock, representing 2.2% of shares outstanding (excluding treasury). The authorized acquisition budget is ¥150.0 million. The acquisition window runs from 10 August through 31 October 2026, with purchases to be executed via open-market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The company states the buyback is intended to improve capital efficiency and provide flexibility for capital allocation, including funding for employee incentive plans in response to changing business conditions. As of 30 June 2026, the company held 1,602,204 treasury shares against 45,089,796 shares outstanding ex-treasury.
